rows.text: “Would you like to buy my hair?”
rows.context: “Would you like to buy my hair?”
rows.basis: Della asks the shop owner to buy her hair.
The shop owner offers to pay twenty dollars for Della’s hair.
Della asks the shop owner to cut off her hair.

rows.text: “Please, let me still look pretty to him,”
rows.context: “Please, let me still look pretty to him,” she said softly.
rows.basis: Della softly hopes she will still look pretty to Jim.

rows.text: “Jim, I sold my hair to buy you a Christmas gift. It will grow back!”
rows.context: “Jim, I sold my hair to buy you a Christmas gift. It will grow back!”
rows.basis: Della explains to Jim that she sold her hair to buy him a gift.

rows.text: “It won’t take long for my hair to grow.”
rows.context: “It won’t take long for my hair to grow.”
rows.basis: Della comments that her hair will grow back soon.

rows.text: “See how beautiful it is! Let me have your watch.”
rows.context: “See how beautiful it is! Let me have your watch.”
rows.basis: Della shows Jim the watch chain and asks to see his watch.

rows.text: “To buy your combs, I had to sell my watch.”
rows.context: “To buy your combs, I had to sell my watch.”
rows.basis: Jim explains that he sold his watch to buy Della’s combs.
